title: Manual aria-hidden + tabindex=-1 vs Native inert Attribute

before.label: Manual aria-hidden + tabindex Loops
before.previewNote: Misses dynamically inserted buttons and fails to block pointer clicks.

after.label: Native HTML inert Attribute
after.code:
shell.inert = isDrawerOpen;
// Single boolean blocks focus, clicks, selection, find-in-page, and A11y tree
after.previewNote: Engine-enforced across all existing and future descendants.
